content.short: Our vision is to create an NFT Viking ecosystem that empowers NFT enthusiasts with knowledge, opportunity, and community.
content.description:
The NFT Vikings don't fit neatly into a single category. It's not an alpha group. It's not a DAO. It's not a PFP project. It's not a content hub. We are a multi-faceted community that forges its own unique path. Education, art, and community are what distinguish the NFT Vikings from other projects and communities. Our main focus has been, and will exceedingly continue to be, on education. This includes our content hub, CardanoThor content, newsletter, tools, and other community resources. We also focus on high-quality NFT projects and NFT artists. In fact, one of our goals is to help talented artists reach their full potential on Cardano by providing a marketing platform and a community of collectors. Lastly, we believe that there is no greater utility than genuine human connection. The Viking Squad started as a small community that has grown into a family that shares common goals and values. This will always be at the heart of everything that the NFT Vikings do and come before any profit-driven goals. Our goal is to represent the NFT and Cardano communities in the best possible way. We actively promote inclusion, open-mindedness, individuality, and kindness. This should be apparent in everything the NFT Vikings do in the space. In particular, we value the following: Long-term thinking Critical (individual) thinking Kindness & Community
